main_text.p: ales excedunt venosas: his nervi ex osse sacro prosilientes copulantur, & simul ad anteriora progredientes, degenerant in quasdam corpora spongiformia. & ubi ad latera corporis glandulosi & cervicis vesicæ aliquantisper progressa fuerint, gradatim ampliora redduntur, simulq; conjuncta membrum virile efformant, quod toti medio ofsis pubis inhærendo, tandem extra corpus aperte propendet.
In pene considerantur, præter musculos motus, etiam organa, tunicæ, glans, præputium & fræœnum.
Tunicæ sunt nervosæ, membranosæ, densæ & robustæ, obducentes spongiformem penis substantiam, ne spiritus influens per porositates spongiformes exhalet.Virga Tu-nica.

Glans est extrema pars penis glandulosa seu carnosa, excedens ambitu reliquum penis corpus, ut pro ratione magnitudinis suæ, veluti cucurbitulæ fundus, magis spiritibus inflatus incalesce-ret.Virga glans.
Præputium est pellis integens glandem, quæ in actu venereo arctiore motu & attritu glandem plurimum calefacit.Præputi-um.

page.notes: Show-through of text from the reverse page is visible faintly in the middle of the page and is omitted. Two words in the first line, "ales" and "ofsis", are read as printed but are uncertain. The printed "præputium" and "fræœnum" spellings are kept. The word "fræœnum" is printed as "fraenum" with a ligature; the reading is uncertain and should be checked. The catchword "Fra-" is at the foot right and is given in bottom_margin only.
